entities.name: Christos Staïkouras
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Christos Staikouras is a Greek economist and elected member of the Greek Parliament for the period 2023-2027. Since the 2007 legislative election, he has been a Member of the Hellenic Parliament (MP) for Phthiotis. After the 2019 election, he was appointed minister for finance in the Cabinet of Kyriakos Mitsotakis serving from 2019 to 2023.

entities.summary: Christos Staikouras is a Greek economist and elected member of the Greek Parliament for the period 2023-2027. Since the 2007 legislative election, he has been a Member of the Hellenic Parliament (MP) for Phthiotis. After the 2019 election, he was appointed minister for finance in the Cabinet of Kyriakos Mitsotakis serving from 2019 to 2023.
